sloka: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम् ।आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम् ॥४-२७-१॥
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve praviṣṭe vānare guhām ।ājagāma saha bhrātrā rāmaḥ prasravaṇam girim ॥4-27-1॥

translations.english: After the consecration, Sugriva entered the cavecity (of Kishkinda) and Rama accompanied by his brother reached mountain Prasravana.
